items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: I played with Eddie Jackson brass, and I played with the Tuxedo Brass Band for quite a while.

ctx.x: I don't remember, I've heard of him.

Well, I had him. And that's when I started out in the brass band. Well, we played in the brass band. I played with the Excelsior Band for maybe two, three years. Then I left the Excelsior Brass Band, I went with the Tuxedo Brass Band, which the leader of the band was Eddie Jackson. Yeah, I put a talk of him.
Oh yeah, some big tuba players.
